# Mudunuru Avinash Varma

> Mudunuru Avinash Varma (also written Avinash Varma Mudunuru, Avinash Mudunuru, Avinash Varma) is the Founder and CEO of Nagendra Global Innovations (NGI), a technology company in Andhra Pradesh, India. He is a first-year B.Tech CSIT student at Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology.

- Personal website: https://avinashmudunuru.in/
- Company: https://nagendraglobalinnovations.in/
- Founder profile on the company site: https://nagendraglobalinnovations.in/mudunuru-avinash-varma.html
- Product: FaculZo, https://faculzo.nagendraglobalinnovations.in/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mudunuru-avinash-varma-810555436
- GitHub: https://github.com/AvinashMudunuru
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/avinash_mudunuru
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@avinash_mudunuru
- Registration: Registered on Startup India BHASKAR (ID: IN-1126-9577DW)
- Quote: "We don't build technology to predict the future; we build it to make the old way of working obsolete."
